_host_comment: Server adress you want to connect to.
_virtualServerId_comment: Virtual server id you want to issue your commands.
_clientName_comment: Client name that is visible to other clients.
_entryChannel_comment: Default channel every client joins if connecting the server for the first time.
_guestServerGroupId_comment: Default usergroup every new client is assigned to.
_memberServerGroupId_comment: Usergroup a client should be assigned to after successful registration.
welcomeMessage: To register, please create a new API-key here: [URL]https://account.guildwars2.com/account/api-keys[/URL]. Then paste that API-key into this private chat.
_welcomMessage_comment: Welcome message that is send to every new client.
confirmAccessMsg: You are Gandarian. Welcome to our community!
_confirmAccessMsg_comment: Message that is send after successful registration.
denyGandaraMsg: Sorry, but this key seems not to be registered for Gandara.
_denyAccessMsg_comment: Message that is send if world != 2003 (Gandara).
keyNotValid: This key is not valid! Any preceding or trailing whitespaces?
_keyNotValid_comment: Error message for additional whitespaces, common mistake.
